task:
Migrate an existing Ingress to the Kubernetes Gateway API.

Context: An Ingress named 'shop-ingress' exists in namespace 'shop'. Your task is to replace it with a Gateway + HTTPRoute.

Step 1 — Inspect the existing Ingress:
  kubectl get ingress shop-ingress -n shop -o yaml
  # Note: routes /api -> api-svc:8080 and / -> frontend-svc:80

Step 2 — Create a GatewayClass (if not present):
  kubectl get gatewayclass
  # Use the existing gatewayclass name from your cluster

Step 3 — Create a Gateway named 'shop-gateway' in namespace 'shop':
  apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
  kind: Gateway
  metadata:
    name: shop-gateway
    namespace: shop
  spec:
    gatewayClassName: <existing-gatewayclass-name>
    listeners:
    - name: http
      protocol: HTTP
      port: 80

Step 4 — Create an HTTPRoute named 'shop-route' in namespace 'shop':
  apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
  kind: HTTPRoute
  metadata:
    name: shop-route
    namespace: shop
  spec:
    parentRefs:
    - name: shop-gateway
    rules:
    - matches:
      - path:
          type: PathPrefix
          value: /api
      backendRefs:
      - name: api-svc
        port: 8080
    - matches:
      - path:
          type: PathPrefix
          value: /
      backendRefs:
      - name: frontend-svc
        port: 80

Step 5 — Delete the old Ingress:
  kubectl delete ingress shop-ingress -n shop

Verify:
  kubectl get gateway shop-gateway -n shop
  kubectl get httproute shop-route -n shop
hints: Gateway API is GA in Kubernetes v1.31+ — apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1
GatewayClass must exist first — use kubectl get gatewayclass to find available classes
HTTPRoute parentRefs points to the Gateway by name
PathPrefix /api must be listed BEFORE / (more specific paths first)
detailed_hints: Install Gateway API CRDs if missing: kubectl apply -f https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/gateway-api/releases/download/v1.1.0/standard-install.yaml
GatewayClass name depends on your CNI/ingress controller (nginx, cilium, etc.)
kubectl describe gateway shop-gateway -n shop  shows conditions and assigned address
HTTPRoute spec.rules[].matches[].path.type options: Exact, PathPrefix, RegularExpression

validators.command: kubectl get gateway shop-gateway -n shop -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get gateway shop-gateway -n shop -o jsonpath='{.spec.listeners[0].port}'
kubectl get httproute shop-route -n shop -o jsonpath='{.metadata.name}'
kubectl get httproute shop-route -n shop -o jsonpath='{.spec.parentRefs[0].name}'
